تتراشقون (form VI)
# تَتَرَاشَقُونَ (tatarāšaqūna) /ta.ta.raː.ʃa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# تُتَرَاشَقُونَ (tutarāšaqūna) /tu.ta.raː.ʃa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
